facts.fact: probe_bots.py runs a bot match and checks: the process stays alive and exits 0, the expected bot indices report, every bot has samples, each bot boards within 60 game seconds, no bot is stuck over 10 s, over half the bots score, NeuroHack attempts occur on BattleArmor maps, the scoreboard lists all bots, and every bot moves. Exit 0 pass, 1 criterion failed, 2 setup or navigation failure.
facts.how_to_use: python probe_bots.py <name> --game-type <n> --red N --blue N --dry-run. Navigation after the Multiplayer hub is unverified.

facts.title: Locomotion test environment
facts.fact: RECOMP_LOCO_TEST=1|2|3 selects the method. RECOMP_LOCO_BOTS=bot:kind, with kind 0 any, 1 pilot, 2 Mech, 3 BattleArmor, 4 tank and 5 VTOL. RECOMP_LOCO_DIST (100 m), RECOMP_LOCO_ALT (VTOL +40), RECOMP_LOCO_SPEED, RECOMP_LOCO_RUN, RECOMP_LOCO_TIME (40 s) and RECOMP_LOCO_DELAY (settle time). Phase 1 goes to a node about 100 m away, and phase 2 faces a point 90 degrees right.
facts.how_to_use: REPLAY_EXTRA="RECOMP_BOT_STALL=1;RECOMP_LOCO_TEST=2;RECOMP_LOCO_BOTS=0:1,1:2" python game_lock.py python replay.py l6 110

facts.title: BattleArmor, VTOL and tank test phases
facts.fact: RECOMP_BAVT_TEST=1 with RECOMP_LOCO_TEST=2 runs phase scripts. RECOMP_BAVT_SCRIPT letters: m MoveTo, t turn rate, w actor+0x248, k and u set and clear the VTOL yaw-hold bit, v and n velocity drive, j raw jet, a StartJump plus MoveTo, o, x and z face in place, g close on the target, r native aim, f aim and fire, c BattleArmor clamp. RECOMP_BAVT_PT sets the phase length (8 s).
facts.how_to_use: Defaults: BattleArmor mvnjac, VTOL mwgf, tank momzgrf, Mech or pilot amgrf.

facts.title: Bot environment variables for tests
facts.fact: Bot test hooks include RECOMP_BOT_TRACE, RECOMP_BOT_STALL, RECOMP_BOT_PATHTEST, RECOMP_BOT_NAV_REGION, RECOMP_BOT_FLAGRUN_TEST, RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_TRACE, RECOMP_BOT_WORLD_PAUSE, RECOMP_BOT_JET_SHOW, RECOMP_BOT_CLIMB_TEST, RECOMP_BOT_STUCK_MEMORY, RECOMP_BOT_TEST_JUMP, RECOMP_BOT_TEST_LOWHP, RECOMP_BOT_TEST_PARK, RECOMP_TEST_TURRET_PICK, RECOMP_TEST_TURRET_DRIVE, RECOMP_TEST_PREFER_TANK, RECOMP_HUMAN_ACT and RECOMP_AUDIO_ISR_STATS. The envvars index lists about 100 related names.
facts.how_to_use: Check the envvars.json lookup for the current read sites.

facts.title: Bot settings and their env overrides
facts.fact: The [Bots] section holds Red, Blue, FFA, Skill and AutoBalance. Env overrides are RECOMP_BOTS_RED, RECOMP_BOTS_BLUE, RECOMP_BOTS_FFA, RECOMP_BOTS_SKILL, RECOMP_BOTS_AUTOBALANCE and RECOMP_BOTS_MAX. Defaults are 0, 0, 0, 1 and 1 in the ini. The UI writes the section only when a value changes.
facts.how_to_use: AutoBalance is kept but the literal counts supersede it.

facts.title: Bot text language override
facts.fact: Bot text is chosen from XC_LANGUAGE (7) through the kernel. The kernel currently always answers English. RECOMP_BOT_LANGUAGE=0 to 5 forces a language for testing.
facts.how_to_use: Test-only.

facts.title: New Game bot rows
facts.fact: The Bots rows are three cloned Time Limit barrels with action ids 910 (Red Bots, or Bots in FFA), 920 (Blue Bots, hidden in FFA) and 930 (Bot Skill). They use widget ids 101 to 118 and sit in the root sibling chain after Kill/Scores. Local Xbox mode shows only Game Type and Mission, so the rows lie under Mission at y 212, 241 and 270.
facts.how_to_use: Run staging/bots/ui/build_pc_assets_bots.py instead of build_pc_assets.py.

facts.title: New Game update hook
facts.fact: A hook at the start of the New Game per-frame update sub_226587 calls ma2_bots_newgame_update(menu). It populates the barrels once per screen with Off and 1 to N for Red and Blue, and Green, Regular, Veteran and Elite for Skill. It only runs when session+0x4C == 2. The game-type mapping of value 1 to 0xA happens at 0x226C10.
facts.how_to_use: The hook is byte-identical in patch_bots.py and apply_ui_patches.py, so either can run first.

facts.title: Bot row layout
facts.fact: Bot rows start 29 px below the lowest visible original row, so with Game Type at y 154 and Mission at 183 they sit at Red 212, Blue 241 and Skill 270. In FFA the Bots row is at 212 and Skill at 241. The description field moves down only when the last row would reach it. Widescreen y is 2 px lower.
facts.how_to_use: Expected layout only: no screenshots were taken.

facts.title: Barrel widget ABI
facts.fact: Barrel items are kept in a vector at +0xAC and +0xB0, each 0x1C bytes with the value at +0xC. The selected index is +0x154 and the listener is +0xA8. sub_208C45 adds an item with a wide string, value, a second value and a flag. sub_208BF9 selects by value. sub_1CAA80 finds a child by action, and sub_1639DA resolves a text id to a wide string.
facts.how_to_use: Use the wide string forms; sub_208C9E uses the shared narrow buffer.

facts.title: New Game menu object offsets
facts.fact: The New Game menu keeps its form at menu+0x9C. The widgets are Game Type at +0x74, Mission at +0x70, Public at +0x84, Private at +0x80, Time Limit at +0x7C, Kill/Scores at +0x78, Location at +0x88 and the description at +0x94. The original sets a listener only on 100, 300, 400, 500 and 800.
facts.how_to_use: The bot barrels are clones of Time Limit, so they have no listener.

facts.title: Bot text resolved through the localisation hook
facts.fact: Bot captions use text ids 0x70020001 (Bots), 0x70020002 (Red Bots), 0x70020003 (Blue Bots) and 0x70020004 (Bot Skill). ma2_pc_localized routes ids 0x7002xxxx to ma2_bots_localized. The skill names Green, Regular, Veteran and Elite and the Off label reuse shipped strings at 0x3AC to 0x3AF and 0xBB8.
facts.how_to_use: Captions that fall back to English mean the hook was not reached.

facts.title: Bot callsigns
facts.fact: Bots use 28 ASCII callsigns of at most 9 characters, starting from a per-process base and wrapping. Callsigns that match a human's profile name are skipped (session+0x264 holds the wide profile name).
facts.how_to_use: Names never duplicate the human's profile name.

facts.title: Bot strings in six languages
facts.fact: Bot strings are in English, French, German, Italian, Japanese and Spanish. Only the four row captions use new ids, and the skill names come from the shipped text manager. French, Italian and Spanish 'Off' and skill words are best-effort and were not checked against the game's own strings.
facts.how_to_use: Compare with the retail string table before shipping exact wording.

facts.title: Asset overlay patch for common.mgf
facts.fact: patch_assets.py replaces interface/menus/multi/multi_newgame.ggf inside pc_assets/common.mgf, using the bots transform, and rewrites its directory record with a new CRC, size and offset. It then writes cache.version. The launcher hash-checks both files through Test-Build.json, so a publish must carry common.mgf and cache.version.
facts.how_to_use: python patch_assets.py <package>/pc_assets/common.mgf. It refuses to run when the transform changes nothing.

facts.title: Publish target is PC Release only
facts.fact: From the 2026-10-15 tenth pass on, bots builds publish to PC Release only. PC Release Bots was abandoned with the 2026-10-14 merge. Publish with (--freeze, --stage, --install) and verify_staged.py, with rollback in releaseN/replaced-files-backup.
facts.how_to_use: The current game exe is 15159121 (release20); the release21 editor publish follows that hash.

facts.title: Merge recipe for PC Release and bots
facts.fact: The 2026-10-13 merge recipe is based on the game source tree It ports PC Release-only hunks: the InvertFlight row, the mouse-look split and the VTOL InvertFlight flip. It keeps the bots versions of apu_vp.c, recomp_0020.c, recomp_0005.c and pc_settings.h. recomp_0094, 0095 and 0097 are identical in both.
facts.how_to_use: Historical: the merge was done on 2026-10-14 (57702bc3).

facts.title: First bots merge into PC Release
facts.fact: On 2026-10-14 PC Release changed from c13a0259 to 57702bc3 (map 22055205 to c0210867), built from the game source tree The 11 replaced files are in replaced-files-backup with a receipt. PC Release Bots had the same exe at the time.
facts.how_to_use: Rollback by copying replaced-files-backup over the install.

facts.title: Release pass history (selected)
facts.fact: Release passes went from 57702bc3 (2026-10-14) through 5ae8a563, d3b15831, 79f2286a, 344eaf20, 9d210d29, 22ddd9d4, 91a816a0, b8d4b61c, e4309cdd, dc5ce799, 33c1d29e, 049ccc70 and the editor pass 4c8f1884. Each pass has a sweep with 0 faults.
facts.how_to_use: Use the newest publish folder for the current state.

facts.title: Playthrough capture kit
facts.fact: The playthrough capture kit runs PC Release with automatic diagnostics. Resume copies the latest v28 playthrough into a private profile, and Continue runs inside the game. Exit in game and keep the console open to finish the diagnostics ZIP. The Try-HRTF-Audio, Try-Tank-Physics and Try-Audio-Limiter launchers are experimental trials that keep the saves.

facts.title: game_lock.py limits concurrent runs
facts.fact: Every game launch goes through game_lock.py, which allows at most two game instances at once. The PC blue-screened twice on 2026-10-12 when four to six instances ran together. Use python game_lock.py python replay.py <run> <seconds> for replays.
facts.how_to_use: Separate REPLAY_EXTRA entries with semicolons.

facts.title: Replay environment variables
facts.fact: replay.py sets REPLAY_GAMETYPE, REPLAY_FFA (more than 0 for FFA types), REPLAY_EXTRA (split on semicolons), REPLAY_USERENV=1 with REPLAY_WIDTH=3840 and REPLAY_HEIGHT=1600 for a player's environment, REPLAY_SHOTS=1000 for per-second screenshots and REPLAY_MENUKEYS for the map menu. Map menu order is alphabetical, so 1 is Deliverance and 4 is In Your Face.
facts.how_to_use: Measure camera problems with per-second screenshots of the first 30 s.

facts.title: Release readiness decision
facts.fact: On 2026-10-13 the bot build was declared release-ready for all nine game modes after 10-minute matches ran clean. The later passes add objectives, air and VTOL work and friendly-fire guards.
facts.how_to_use: Historical.

facts.title: Patch scripts are idempotent and anchor-checked
facts.fact: Every bot patch script anchors on exact text, asserts the anchor occurs once, and skips when the replacement is already present, so it can run twice. patch_bots.py takes --check to verify anchors and --generated DIR to patch a copy. Hook edits go into generated files under source/src/recomp/gen.
facts.how_to_use: Run patch_bots.py after patch_pc_frontend.py.

facts.title: UI apply script
facts.fact: apply_ui_patches.py adds ma2_pc_ini_get_int and ma2_pc_ini_set_int beside write_int in pc_native_settings.cpp, declares them in pc_settings.h, routes ids 0x70020000 to 0x70030000 through ma2_bots_localized in pc_prompts.cpp, adds the [Bots] keys to pc_settings.ini and inserts the New Game update call in recomp_0058.c. It is anchored and idempotent.
facts.how_to_use: Run with --check for a dry run, or --print-frontend-entry for the patch_pc_frontend tuple.

facts.title: Bot names and skill knobs (ui2)
facts.fact: patch_ui2.py makes callsigns skip names equal to the human profile name, and applies the Bot Skill knobs to the campaign-AI engagement: a reaction delay before a new engagement, an engage range multiplier and a human threat bias. It adds two test hooks: RECOMP_BOT_TEST_JUMP and RECOMP_BOT_SCOREDUMP=1, which dumps per-player dwords every 10 s.
facts.how_to_use: Run python patch_ui2.py <path to ma2_bots_core.c>.

facts.title: Spatial candidate query trace
facts.fact: patch_ai3.py traces the spatial candidate query sub_18507C. It records the owning actor as the key, and the bots code matches AI.owner.
facts.how_to_use: Diagnostic.

facts.title: Exact entry zones integrated
facts.fact: patch_entry_integration.py adds the exact entry zone (has_entry, entry and entry_r) to Ma2VehicleView, gives each vehicle its live zone, and lets the brain walk to the zone's circle. A vehicle without an active zone, or of an enemy nation in team modes, is not usable.
facts.how_to_use: Run after the game source tree is installed.

facts.title: Catalogue dumps and projectile speeds
facts.fact: RECOMP_DEFENSE_CATALOG=1 walks the template world and each vehicle's WeaponLoadout (actor+0xA0), logging [CAT-VEH], [CAT-WPN], [CAT-GRP] and [DEF-PSPD] projectile speeds.
facts.how_to_use: Use the output to refresh the catalogue.

facts.title: Defence probe run crash on the audio thread
facts.fact: The defence probe run d8 crashed once at t = 96.8 s on the audio thread, when DSOUND sub_3A89C5 read APU MMIO 0xFE000268. This is outside the defence code and was seen once in 14 runs.
facts.how_to_use: Related to the XACT freeze work.

facts.title: Targeting and the scoreboard leader
facts.fact: Bot targeting now weighs the scoreboard leader. The 2026-10-14 CTF Mixed case had a player at 17 kills against a best bot of 7, and the leader weighting was added in response. a player rejected a flat human bias in favour of this approach.
facts.how_to_use: Leader focus can be turned off with RECOMP_BOT_LEADER_FOCUS=0.

facts.title: Requirements from 2026-10-13: Grinder limited to exactly one bot; every other mode supports 6v6 (12 players);
facts.fact: Requirements from 2026-10-13: Grinder limited to exactly one bot; every other mode supports 6v6 (12 players); VTOLs hook and drop power-ups with A and B; BattleArmor can latch onto a VTOL for a ride and must detach when the VTOL takes critical damage; the New River City red-base pass is the only exit from the spawn pocket and Mechs must not walk into the hills.
facts.how_to_use: A requirements list, not an implementation status.

facts.title: VTOL idle fix
facts.fact: A VTOL carrying a power-up with no mate in reach no longer holds the fetch goal. Lift ride hysteresis was also fixed: the ride goal had flapped every 0.3 s.
facts.how_to_use: Fixed in round 9.

facts.title: Watchdog bug with negative time
facts.fact: The forced-stall trick used prog_t = now - 100, which is negative before t = 100 and read as unset. Use a flag instead.
facts.how_to_use: Fixed.

facts.title: Wedge detector resets only on own shots or movement
facts.fact: The wedge detector resets only when the bot fires or moves itself. A Mech had stood 50 s holding fire behind a teammate while the others hurt its target, so the fix stops that reset.
facts.how_to_use: Friendly-fire guard is RECOMP_BOT_FF_GUARD.

facts.title: Friendly-fire guard
facts.fact: The friendly-fire guard stops bots firing through a teammate's line of fire. ctrl_fight strafes away from a teammate in the line, and tac_firing penalises spots with a teammate in the line.
facts.how_to_use: RECOMP_BOT_FF_GUARD gates it.

facts.title: Probe actor freed mid-frame
facts.fact: g_probe.actor, the first bot, was freed mid-frame when a bot pilot finished boarding a VTOL. ray_cast's filter ran IsKindOf on the freed actor. probe_live now checks the vtable and physics back-links.

facts.title: Open game-thread crash in deferred deletion
facts.fact: A game-thread crash in Rush Hour FFA at t=51 walked a tree whose node was freed memory: sub_15D741 calls sub_B5D60, sub_B5350, sub_B4EF0 and sub_B6700. It was not reproduced in four reruns. The cause is open.
facts.how_to_use: Watch in long runs.

facts.title: BFED0 nearest-point guard
facts.fact: sub_BFED0 finds the nearest point in a list, and it spun when the count was corrupt. A guard in recomp_0020.c treats a count above 4096 as empty and logs the owner and count as [BOT-TRACE] lines 40 and 41.
facts.how_to_use: The root cause is the listener overflow fixed in patch_round7.
